title: Fire in process area
goal: Show fire outcomes through detection, suppression, and evacuation success and failure branches.

rubric.must: A fire-in-process-area initiating event and its frequency are visible at the left.
Detection, automatic suppression, and personnel evacuation appear as ordered event-tree function columns.
The tree visibly ends in controlled-fire, escalated-fire, and late-detected-fire outcome categories.
Success and failure branch probabilities are visibly shown for the safety functions.
The failed-detection path visibly terminates directly at the late-detected major-damage outcome.
Evacuation success and failure visibly distinguish personnel-safe from personnel-injury outcomes.

ideal.notes: Updated 2026-09-14 against exemplar visual-eval/exemplars/eventtree/ideal.svg (sha256 064a513719ee). Exemplar safety-function columns, success-upper branching, blue probabilities and aligned outcome-frequency table. Path frequencies independently calculated and checked to sum to the initiating frequency. No unprovided severity categories invented. Visually inspected at full size and across the case family; independent targets, not engine-output snapshots.
